items.summary: In TopBar.tsx, remove any logo image element and replace it with a text-only 'Smileup' wordmark. The wordmark should use the existing brand color combination (e.g., gradient or contrasting accent colors already present on the black page background) and have a clean, professional typographic style — no image assets.

In LandingPage.tsx, remove any logo image element and replace it with the same text-only 'Smileup' wordmark — matching the typographic style and color treatment used in the TopBar. Ensure it reads clearly on the black background.
If the app still references a splash/logo screen in App.tsx (shown during initialization), replace the logo image there too with the same text-only 'Smileup' wordmark for visual consistency.
